strings.dlg.c4p2.e_iri_01.irina: You’ve read the order. In January you showed me three wagons, Aljoscha – this is the fourth.
strings.dlg.c4p2.e_iri_01.secrecy: You’ve read the order. In January you already knew something and kept quiet. Now I know too, Morozov.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_01.named: There you are, Herr Adler. At first I didn’t want to come. Then I thought of Ilse.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_01.protected: There you are. I came straight here after my shift. The 74 was lucky today; nobody stopped it.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_03.named: Last night they came for me. Three hours at the Ring. ‘Frau Vogel, you know a child called Ilse.’ I know a lot of children.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_03.protected: Yesterday a man from the State Police was at the depot. He asked about a gentleman from the Building Office who knew no names at the branch.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_04.named: Marta … at the counter I gave your name. For the Lindner file.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_05.named: I know. The gentleman at the Ring told me – how obliging you’d been. Since this morning I no longer drive the 74, but the 3.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_05.protected: About you, yes. Not about me. You didn’t name me. I won’t forget that.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_09.protected: To their mothers, they say. ‘Family reunification.’ Nobody’s searching my place – not yet. But at the school, at your sister’s.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_mar_11.named: Then I’ll take Ilse to your sister tomorrow evening. For you I’ll do nothing more, Herr Adler. For Ilse, everything.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_ekd_06.admit: I drew a room in which fourteen people wait on a bench. I told him so. He has the other half.
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_ekd_10.report: In Veltrava I reported an incident to Kessler. Morozov knows. Will he even open your book?
strings.dlg.c4p2.f_ekd_11.report: Then write something in it that no Kessler would understand. Page two hundred and twelve. The train leaves at ten past nine.
strings.dlg.c4p2.g_ekd_02.secrecy: A signal says whether the line is clear. Not who runs on it.
strings.dlg.c4p2.g_ekd_06.report: Adler. Who reported me to Kessler in Veltrava.
strings.dlg.c4p2.g_ekd_07.named: He says you collect numbers. And he enclosed a page from a file – with a name he should never have given.
strings.dlg.c4p2.g_lev_04.swap: In a Swedish guidebook. The same German who carries Pjotr’s name through Berlin put it there.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_han_01.named: You’re late, Konrad. Marta brought her at nine, with a bag of apples. She had no word for you.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_han_01.protected: You’re late, Konrad. Marta brought her at nine. She sends her regards – says you’re the only one from the office who gives no names.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_han_06.admit: Yes. I drew it. Like the room with the bench for fourteen. I am telling you before someone else does.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_wen_01.named: Herr Adler. On Sunday you gave us an informant, Frau Vogel. That was most helpful.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_wen_01.protected: Herr Adler. On Sunday you gave no name at the South Branch. Those who give none usually have one.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_wen_03.suspicion: At half past eleven. Your office was already asking about you in January, Herr Adler. You are a thorough man.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_wen_04.admit: I hatched this house. I wanted to see who lives in it before I do it again.
strings.dlg.c4p2.h_wen_08.report: All in order. In Veltrava you reported an incident to Herr Kessler. I do hope you stay so helpful, Herr Adler.
strings.choice.c4g.publish_now.marta: Give Ekdahl everything – the film, Lev’s carbons, even the page with Marta Vogel’s name – so that he stands at Door East at 23:40
strings.choice.c4g.protect_first.marta: Keep the film and give Ekdahl only the numbers – Konrad protected Marta’s name, I’ll protect Lev’s
strings.dlg.c4p2.react.publish_now.elena: Then I’ll get off at Kordon-17 and stand at Door East at 23:40. Afterwards I’ll ask in Veltrava about a coat, ticket 27.
strings.dlg.c4p2.react.publish_now: Then I’ll get off at Kordon-17 and stand at Door East at 23:40, with a flash. Your name I’ll leave out. The others, no.
strings.dlg.c4p2.react.protect_first: No newspaper prints numbers without names, Herr Morozov. Keep the film. If you call, I’ll come back.
